simple.meaning: אַלְמָנוּת (ʼalmânûwth) is a Hebrew object word meaning “concrete, a widow ; abstract, widowhood.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 38:14. The surrounding context includes kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אַלְמָנוּת (H491) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: אַלְמָנוּת (ʼalmânûwth) / H491 is traced through Genesis 38:14, Genesis 38:19, 2 Samuel 20:3, Isaiah 54:4 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: She took off the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of Enaim, which is on the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she wasn’t given to him as a wife.

majorEvents.label: Removal or rescue
majorEvents.evidenceText: She arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

timeline.evidenceText: She took off the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of Enaim, which is on the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she wasn’t given to him as a wife.
She arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in custody, and provided them with sustenance, but didn’t go in to them. So they were shut up to the day of their death, living in widowhood.
“Don’t be afraid, for you will not be ashamed.

definitions.full: H491. almanuth [ אַלְמָנוּת ] noun feminine widowhood (Mishna id. , Phoenician אלמת ) suffix אַלְמְנוּתָהּ בִּגְדֵי her widow's garments Gen 38:14 , 19 ; construct חַיּוּת אַלְמְנוּת 2Sam 20:3 (of David's imprisoned concubines; but text impossible; ᵐ5 We חַיּוֺת אַלְמָנוֺת , compare Dr; Klo thinks gloss); figurative of Jerusalem Isa 54:4 אַלְמְנוּתַיִח .
